name: Tradelle
summary: Dropshipping product research, competitor store data and order fulfillment for Shopify sellers, with an AI store builder and one-click product imports.
best_for: new and growing Shopify dropshippers who want product research, competitor store data and fulfillment in one tool, and who will use the tier quotas
skip_if: you sell on TikTok Shop US/UK or WooCommerce (the help centre says fulfillment is not available there), or you want a free plan, because the only entry is a paid $1 trial
honest_knock: The subscription is only the start of the bill: every fulfilled order is charged separately for product and shipping, and Tradelle's product prices exclude VAT. The terms and the help centre also disagree on downgrades and pauses, so what you can do with an existing subscription is unclear until you try it.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Lite · Lite billed monthly, 1 connected store, 25 product imports and 100 orders shipped by Tradelle a month
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-08 on tradelle.io/pricing, US dollars) Tradelle sells dropshipping product research and order fulfillment in three subscription tiers plus a one-time Lifetime Max. Lite is $29.99 a month, or $19.99 a month billed as $239.88 a year; Starter is $49.99 a month, or $32.50 a month billed as $390 a year; Pro is $79.99 a month, or $54.99 a month billed as $659.88 a year. Lifetime Max is $1,299 once. The tiers differ by quota: Lite has 1 connected store, 25 product imports and 100 orders shipped by Tradelle a month; Starter 3 stores, 250 imports and 500 orders; Pro is unlimited on all of those. Every plan starts with a 7-day trial for $1 after which the selected plan begins; the terms say the $1 is non-refundable. The page also shows a 14-day money-back guarantee. The subscription is not the whole cost: fulfilled orders are charged separately for product cost and shipping, once a day, and Tradelle's product prices exclude VAT. We did not open a checkout, so optional add-ons offered there are unknown.
